mapper.sql: r.id, r.receipt_no, r.order_id, r.order_no, r.user_id, r.channel, r.account_id, r.amount, r.paid_at, r.status, r.audit_by, r.audit_name, r.audit_time, r.remark, r.is_deleted, r.create_time, r.update_time, u.name AS user_name, a.account_name, o.order_status, o.consignee, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM after_sales s WHERE s.order_id = r.order_id AND s.status = 'refunded' AND s.is_deleted = 0) AS refunded, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s2.refund_amount), 0) FROM after_sales s2 WHERE s2.order_id = r.order_id AND s2.status = 'refunded' AND s2.is_deleted = 0) AS refund_amount
FROM finance_receipt r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN finance_account a ON a.id = r.account_id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = r.order_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_receipt (receipt_no, order_id, order_no, user_id, channel, account_id, amount, paid_at, status, is_deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{receiptNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{channel}, #{accountId}, #{amount}, #{paidAt}, 0, 0, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_receipt WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, receipt_no, order_id, order_no, user_id, channel, account_id, amount, paid_at, status, audit_by, audit_name, audit_time, remark, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM finance_receipt WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE finance_receipt
status = 1, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_name = #{auditName}, audit_time = #{now}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{now},
WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM finance_receipt WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status = 0
